'''Xiaowei Zhuang''' ({{lang-zh|s=庄小威|t=莊小威|p=Zhuāng Xiǎowēi}}; born 21 January 1972) is a Chinese-American [[biophysicist]] who is the David B. Arnold Jr. Professor of Science, Professor of Chemistry and Chemical Biology, and Professor of Physics at [[Harvard University]],<ref>{{cite web|url=http://zhuang.harvard.edu/ |title=Zhuang Lab Webpage |publisher=zhuang.harvard.edu |access-date=2015-09-21}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=http://chemistry.harvard.edu/people/xiaowei-zhuang |title=Harvard Chemistry and Chemical Biology Faculty: Xiaowei Zhuang |access-date=2015-09-21}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.physics.harvard.edu/people/facpages/zhuang |title=Harvard Physics Faculty: Xiaowei Zhuang |access-date=2015-09-21 |archive-date=2015-09-19 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150919071810/https://www.physics.harvard.edu/people/facpages/zhuang }}</ref> and an Investigator at the [[Howard Hughes Medical Institute]].<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.hhmi.org/research/investigators/zhuang_bio.html |title=HHMI Scientist Bio: Xiaowei Zhuang, Ph.D |publisher=Hhmi.org |access-date=2012-06-29 |archive-date=2013-05-14 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20130514120030/http://www.hhmi.org/research/investigators/zhuang_bio.html }}</ref> She is best known for her work in the development of [[Stochastic optical reconstruction microscopy|Stochastic Optical Reconstruction Microscopy (STORM)]],<ref name="rust_2006">{{cite journal| title=  Sub-diffraction-limit imaging by stochastic optical reconstruction microscopy (STORM)| doi=10.1038/nmeth929 | volume=3 | journal=Nature Methods | pages=793–796| pmc=2700296 | pmid=16896339 | year=2006 | last1 = Rust | first1 = MJ | last2 = Bates | first2 = M | last3 = Zhuang | first3 = X| issue=10 }}</ref><ref name="bates_2007">{{cite journal| title= Multicolor Super-Resolution Imaging with Photo-Switchable Fluorescent Probes| doi=10.1126/science.1146598 | volume=317 | journal=Science | pages=1749–1753| bibcode=2007Sci...317.1749B| pmc=2633025 | pmid=17702910 | date=September 2007 | last1 = Bates | first1 = M | last2 = Huang | first2 = B | last3 = Dempsey | first3 = GT | last4 = Zhuang | first4 = X| issue=5845 }}</ref><ref name="huang_2008">{{cite journal| title= Three-Dimensional Super-Resolution Imaging by Stochastic Optical Reconstruction Microscopy| doi=10.1126/science.1153529 | volume=319 | journal=Science | pages=810–813| bibcode=2008Sci...319..810H| pmc=2633023 | pmid=18174397 | date=February 2008 | last1 = Huang | first1 = B | last2 = Wang | first2 = W | last3 = Bates | first3 = M | last4 = Zhuang | first4 = X| issue=5864 }}</ref> a super-resolution fluorescence microscopy method, and the discoveries of novel cellular structures using STORM. She received a 2019 [[Breakthrough Prize in Life Sciences]] for developing super-resolution imaging techniques that get past the diffraction limits of traditional light microscopes, allowing scientists to visualize small structures within living cells.<ref name=":0">{{Cite web|url=https://breakthroughprize.org/News/47|title=Breakthrough Prize – Winners of the 2019 Breakthrough Prize in Life Sciences, Fundamental Physics and Mathematics Announced|website=breakthroughprize.org|language=en|access-date=2018-10-18}}</ref> She was elected a Member of the [[American Philosophical Society]] in 2019 and was awarded a [[Vilcek Foundation]] Prize in Biomedical Science in 2020.<ref name="Xiaowei Zhuang">{{Cite web|url=https://vilcek.org/prizes/prize-recipients/xiaowei-zhuang/|title=Xiaowei Zhuang|website=Vilcek Foundation|language=en-US|access-date=2020-02-03}}</ref>

==Early life and education==
Zhuang's father Zhuang Lixian ({{lang|zh|庄礼贤}})<ref>{{cite web |url=http://mech.ustc.edu.cn/2012/1116/c4589a42143/page.htm |title=庄礼贤中科大主页 |trans-title=Zhuang Lixian, University of Science and Technology of China homepage |website=mech.ustc.edu.cn}}</ref> and mother Zhu Renzhi ({{lang|zh|朱仁芝}}) are both professors at the [[University of Science and Technology of China]] (USTC).<ref>{{cite web |url=http://pmpi.ustc.edu.cn/2012/0925/c4118a38575/page.htm |title=朱仁芝中科大主页 |trans-title=Zhu Renzhi, University of Science and Technology of China homepage |website=pmpi.ustc.edu.c}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=http://news.sciencenet.cn/htmlnews/2014/4/292321.shtm |title=美国科学院院士庄小威：庄家有女是奇才 |trans-title=Xiaowei Zhuang, an academician of the National Academy of Sciences: A woman in the Zhuang family is a genius |website=news.sciencenet.cn}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=http://news.ustc.edu.cn/kdb/200202/t20020220_62368.html |title=《中国科大报》551期 |trans-title="China University of Science and Technology News" Issue 551 |website=news.ustc.edu.cn |access-date=2018-01-16 |archive-date=2018-01-16 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180116140017/http://news.ustc.edu.cn/kdb/200202/t20020220_62368.html }}</ref>

Zhuang graduated from the [[University of Science and Technology of China|USTC]] with a BS in physics in 1991. She obtained her PhD in physics from the [[University of California, Berkeley]] in 1996 and conducted her thesis research under the supervision of Dr. [[Yuen-Ron Shen]]. In 1997–2001, she was a Chodorow Postdoctoral Fellow in the laboratory of Dr. [[Steven Chu]] at [[Stanford University]]. She started her faculty position in the Department of Chemistry and Chemical Biology and the Department of Physics at [[Harvard University]] in 2001 and was promoted to full professor in 2006.<ref name=":1">{{Cite news|url=https://news.harvard.edu/gazette/story/2018/10/harvards-xiaowei-zhuang-awarded-2018-breakthrough-prize/|title=Xiaowei Zhuang receives 2019 Breakthrough Prize in Life Sciences|date=2018-10-17|work=Harvard Gazette|access-date=2018-10-18|language=en-US}}</ref>

She was named a [[Howard Hughes Medical Institute|Howard Hughes Medical]] Investigator in 2005.<ref name=":1" />

==Research==
Zhuang's laboratory invented [[Stochastic optical reconstruction microscopy|Stochastic Optical Reconstruction Microscopy (STORM)]], a single-molecule-based super-resolution fluorescence microscopy method.<ref name="rust_2006"/> The Zhuang laboratory demonstrated three-dimensional super-resolution imaging with STORM.<ref name="huang_2008"/> The Zhuang laboratory also discovered several photoswitchable dye molecules<ref name="bates_2007"/><ref>{{cite journal| title= Short-Range Spectroscopic Ruler Based on a Single-Molecule Optical Switch| doi=10.1103/PhysRevLett.94.108101 | bibcode=2005PhRvL..94j8101B | volume=94 | journal=Physical Review Letters| arxiv=q-bio/0502012 | year=2005 | last1 = Bates | first1 = Mark | issue=10 | pmid=15783528 | pmc=2652517 | article-number=108101}}</ref><ref name="shim_2012">{{cite journal| title= Super-resolution fluorescence imaging of organelles in live cells with photoswitchable membrane probes| doi=10.1073/pnas.1201882109 | volume=109 | journal=Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences | pages=13978–13983| bibcode=2012PNAS..10913978S| pmc=3435176 | pmid=22891300 | year=2012 | last1 = Shim | first1 = SH | last2 = Xia | first2 = C | last3 = Zhong | first3 = G | last4 = Babcock | first4 = HP | last5 = Vaughan | first5 = JC | last6 = Huang | first6 = B | last7 = Wang | first7 = X | last8 = Xu | first8 = C | last9 = Bi | first9 = GQ | last10 = Zhuang | first10 = X| issue=35 | doi-access=free }}</ref> that enabled STORM imaging and demonstrated live-cell STORM imaging.<ref name="shim_2012"/><ref>{{cite journal| title= Fast, three-dimensional super-resolution imaging of live cells| doi=10.1038/nmeth.1605 | volume=8 | journal=Nature Methods | pages=499–505| pmc=3137767 | pmid=21552254 | date=June 2011 | last1 = Jones | first1 = SA | last2 = Shim | first2 = SH | last3 = He | first3 = J | last4 = Zhuang | first4 = X| issue=6 }}</ref>

Using STORM, Zhuang and colleagues have studied a variety of biological systems, ranging from single-cell organisms to complex brain tissues. These studies led to the discovery of novel cellular structures, such as the periodic membrane skeletons in the axons of neurons<ref>{{cite journal| title= Actin, Spectrin, and Associated Proteins Form a Periodic Cytoskeletal Structure in Axons| doi=10.1126/science.1232251 | volume=339 | journal=Science | pages=452–456| bibcode=2013Sci...339..452X| pmc=3815867 | pmid=23239625 | year=2013 | last1 = Xu | first1 = K | last2 = Zhong | first2 = G | last3 = Zhuang | first3 = X| issue=6118 }}</ref><ref>{{cite journal| title= Developmental mechanism of the periodic membrane skeleton in axons| doi=10.7554/eLife.04581 | volume=3 | journal=eLife| pmc=4337613| pmid=25535840| year=2014 | last1 = Zhong | first1 = G | last2 = He | first2 = J | last3 = Zhou | first3 = R | last4 = Lorenzo | first4 = D | last5 = Babcock | first5 = HP | last6 = Bennett | first6 = V | last7 = Zhuang | first7 = X | doi-access=free }}</ref> and provided insights into many other cellular structures.<ref>{{cite journal| title= Superresolution Imaging of Chemical Synapses in the Brain| doi=10.1016/j.neuron.2010.11.021 | volume=68 | journal=Neuron | pages=843–856 | year=2010 | last1 = Dani | first1 = Adish | issue=5 | pmid=21144999 | pmc=3057101}}</ref><ref>{{cite journal| title= Super-Resolution Fluorescence Imaging of Telomeres Reveals TRF2-Dependent T-loop Formation| doi=10.1016/j.cell.2013.09.048 | volume=155 | journal=Cell | pages=345–356 | year=2013 | last1 = Doksani | first1 = Ylli | last2 = Wu | first2 = John Y. | last3 = de Lange | first3 = Titia | last4 = Zhuang | first4 = Xiaowei| issue=2 | pmid=24120135 | pmc=4062873 | doi-access = free }}</ref><ref>{{cite journal| title= Structurally Distinct Ca2+ Signaling Domains of Sperm Flagella Orchestrate Tyrosine Phosphorylation and Motility| doi=10.1016/j.cell.2014.02.056 | volume=157 | journal=Cell | pages=808–822 | year=2014 | last1 = Chung | first1 = Jean-Ju | last2 = Shim | first2 = Sang-Hee | last3 = Everley | first3 = Robert A. | last4 = Gygi | first4 = Steven P. | last5 = Zhuang | first5 = Xiaowei | last6 = Clapham | first6 = David E.| issue=4 | pmid=24813608 | pmc=4032590 | doi-access = free }}</ref>

The Zhuang laboratory invented a single-cell transcriptome imaging method, MERFISH (multiplexed error-robust fluorescence in situ hybridization), which allows numerous RNA species to be imaged and quantified in single cells in their native context.<ref>{{cite journal| title= Spatially resolved, highly multiplexed RNA profiling in single cells| doi=10.1126/science.aaa6090 | volume=348 | journal=Science | article-number=aaa6090 | year=2015 | last1 = Chen | first1 = K. R. | last4 = Wang | first4 = S. | last5 = Zhuang | first5 = X. | issue=6233 | pmid=25858977 | pmc=4662681}}</ref> Zhuang and colleagues used single-molecule FRET to study biomolecules and molecular pages=1022–1027| bibcode=2009Natur.462.1022B | pmc=2835771 | pmid=20033040 | year=2009 | last1 = Blosser | first1 = TR | last2 = Yang | first2 = JG | last3 = Stone | first3 = MD | last4 = Narlikar | first4 = GJ | last5 = Zhuang | first5 = X| issue=7276 }}</ref><ref>{{cite journal| title= Histone H4 tail mediates allosteric regulation of nucleosome remodelling by linker DNA|
